This project is a Python-based Telegram bot for automating token trending on Dextools, Dexscreener, CoinMarketCap, and Twitter. It supports ETH, BNB, and SOL chains, and includes modules for input handling, platform automation, scheduling, payments, logging, undetectability, Docker deployment, and dashboard management. All code must be error-free and production-ready.
